properties.address: The Mission Church, Street, Street BA16 0HZ
properties.description: Offering a warm welcome, coffee (or tea), snacks and the chance for a friendly chat, why not come along to the Mission Church, any Saturday, from 10.30 am - 12 noon? We can promise the building will be warm and comfortable; there is free wifi and parking, disabled access and easy pedestrian routes from the centre of Street, not to mention comfy chairs! Whoever you are, whatever your circumstances and whether or not you have ever stepped inside a church in your life before, you would be welcome.
properties.title: Coffee chat and snacks

properties.address: The Gateway Centre, Bath, Somerset BA1 6DH
properties.description: Genesis Life Projects refers to all of the face-to-face work we do with homeless and vulnerable people at our Gateway Centre in Bath. Through the interlinked projects, we meet the immediate needs of homeless and vulnerable people in Bath and the surrounding area, but also journey alongside people supporting them with issues like trauma, addictions, mental ill-health, effects of isolation and much more. Genesis Life Projects include: 1. Lifeline - Day-centre with crisis support 2. Life Skills - A range of health and well-being activities 3. Life Recovery - For people recovering from or in active addiction 4. Life Connect - Healthy meals and relational connection 5. Life Thrive - Tailored one-to-one support
properties.title: Genesis Life Projects

properties.description: This space is open to all and is situated in the centre of Glastonbury. When you become a library member we offer free WIFI and public computers, a stand on health monitor which measures your weight height and blood pressure, alongside access to a variety of activities and groups. We have study areas, books, online council access help via video link and comfy chairs. Membership is free and items to borrow include books, eBooks, audio books, blood pressure monitors, iPads and smart watches. During the winter months we are a warm space for all and offer a warm winter coat exchange.

properties.address: The Crispin Community Centre, Leigh Road, Street, Somerset ba16 0ha
properties.description: Our coffee room is open to all, all year round! This Winter, we are offering free hot drinks and refreshments throughout the day. On Mondays mornings we serve bacon baps and on Tuesday mornings we serve cheese toasties from 10am-12noon. We serve hot, homemade soup with toast Monday to Friday from 1pm-4pm. We always have wonderful volunteers to serve and have a chat with. As a charity, we also host lots of affordable activities such as Tai Chi, seated exercise, lunch clubs and social opportunities including art, games and a group designed especially for adults living with dementia. We also run family fun sessions in school holidays, all inclusive discos and a volunteer driver service. You can find out about all of these by popping in and seeing us or checking out our Facebook page.
